Title: Blood from the Edge and Intercept Gaining - LSJ

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
Heather Florent refers to blood gained from the edge. How wide-ranging
is this? Is this only the blood gained from having the edge at the
start of your turn? Would it count blood gained by Victoria allowing
you to forfeit the edge? Would it count blood gained from Using the
Advantage? ie Could I put blood from Victoria and Using the Advantage
onto Heather?

I think that Using the Advantage is a no-no, but I was in two minds
about Victoria but Using the Advantage made me think that that was a no-
no too.

Also, how does Andreas work with regard to his intercept gaining
ability? How long does it last? That action? That turn?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
James Coupe wrote:
>
> Heather Florent refers to blood gained from the edge. How wide-ranging
> is this? Is this only the blood gained from having the edge at the
> start of your turn? Would it count blood gained by Victoria allowing
> you to forfeit the edge? Would it count blood gained from Using the
> Advantage? ie Could I put blood from Victoria and Using the Advantage
> onto Heather?

Victoria: pool gained is not from the Edge, but from Victoria allowing
you to burn the Edge.

Using the Advantage: pool gained is from tapping the card.

i.e. No and no.

> I think that Using the Advantage is a no-no, but I was in two minds
> about Victoria but Using the Advantage made me think that that was a no-
> no too.

Correct.

> Also, how does Andreas work with regard to his intercept gaining
> ability? How long does it last? That action? That turn?

The action.
